name: Driftwood
summary: After The Lost Caravan, Watcher Biggs still has a wagon to mend before reaching Nethergarde. Biggs needs strong, dry wood, and sends you east to the coast to search for driftwood dried by the sun.

sections.title: Wood for the Wagon
sections.body: Watcher Biggs says you are owed great thanks, and asks for your help once more. If Biggs is ever to reach Nethergarde, the wagon must be fixed, and that takes strong, dry wood. Wood from the swamp's trees is spongy and tangled, and will not do.

sections.title: Driftwood from the Coast
sections.body: Biggs sends you east to the coast, to search for driftwood that the sun has dried. Eight pieces are to be brought back to Biggs in the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: Why does Watcher Biggs need wood?
faq.answer: The wagon must be fixed if Biggs is ever to reach Nethergarde, and wood from the swamp's trees is too spongy and tangled.

faq.q: Where does Watcher Biggs send you for the wood?
faq.answer: East to the coast, to search for driftwood that the sun has dried.
The Lost Caravan comes first, and Biggs then asks for more help.
